## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (fmt, clippy, tests)
- [ ] A product behaviour changed: a line in `docs/decisions.md` and its guard in `docs/decision-guards.txt`
- [ ] A feature added or changed: its tutorial step in `src/ui/tutorial.rs`
- [ ] Nothing company-specific: names, repos, URLs and prompts go in a profile
